data.summary: Wrote intent/r20b/dev-plan.md: a single epic (E1, dots-left HUD counter) in six ordered steps: the dotsText helper in render.ts, the #dots span in index.html, the render() wire-up in main.ts, unit tests in game.test.ts, the e2e check in tests/e2e/, and a canon follow-up for CAP-4. Each step states what it delivers and how it is known to be done. Assumptions: "dots" means every dot and pellet cell (the set checkWin uses), the count appears only in the HUD, and the canon update belongs to a seat that owns canon/. No open questions; the tech spec settles every decision the intent leaves open.
